plan.name: Systematic Cabinet Search and Cool Pan Placement
plan.strategy: Search all cabinets systematically to find a pan, cool it in the fridge if necessary, and place it on the stoveburner.
steps: Check each cabinet in order (from cabinet 1 to cabinet 27) to locate a pan.
Once a pan is found, check its temperature. If it is not cool, place it in the fridge to cool.
After the pan is cooled, move it to a stoveburner (e.g., stoveburner 1).
